intro
This is One Verse. A calm, beautiful way to hear the Quran, and see every word.
home
Home suggests the right surah for the moment, and keeps your favourites and bookmarks close.
reader
Press play, and every word lights up exactly as it is recited, while the page follows along.
scripts
Read in five scripts, from Madani to IndoPak and tajweed colours, each in its proper font.
deck
The new player puts everything under your thumb. Reciter, translation, what you hear, repeat and speed. One tap each.
reciters
Choose from more than fifty reciters, and keep your favourites on top.
memorise
Memorising? Loop a few ayahs as many times as you need, with a pause to recite from memory.
tafseer
Open the tafseer of any ayah. Ibn Kathir, Bayan ul Quran, and more, in Urdu, English and Arabic.
bookmark
Bookmark an ayah, and keep your own note with it.
progress
Build a daily habit with streaks and listening goals. Download the complete Quran, and listen offline.
outro
One Verse. Free, with no ads, and no account. Get it on Google Play.
